Docs.summary: Provides Android APIs for writing protobuf data and identifying field wire types.

remarks.para: writes fields using identifiers that combine a field number with type and count flags. Use to retrieve an in-memory result, or to write the result to the output stream supplied to the constructor.
contains the wire type codes used in field tags and a mask for extracting them. Field identifiers, encoded field tags, and nested-object tokens have different layouts.
See the AOSP implementations of ProtoOutputStream and ProtoStream for these formats.
